name: Magistrate
overview: The Bible presents magistrates as officers of civil law who maintain order and enforce justice, as seen in Ezra 7:25 where magistrates and judges are appointed to govern according to God's wisdom. The absence of a magistrate leads to careless and unrestrained living, illustrated in Judges 18:7. Believers are instructed to respect and obey magistrates and powers, even when brought before them, as Luke 12:11 and 12:58 advise readiness and diligence in such encounters. The role of magistrates in administering punishment is also evident in Acts 16, where they exercise authority to judge and discipline.
